description.value: The Whalley Legion Branch 229 is a Royal Canadian Legion chapter that has served the North Surrey community since 1948, operating the Vimy Lounge — a full pub and restaurant open to the public. The lounge features 14 big-screen TVs, a large dance floor, pool tables, darts, and live entertainment on weekends, alongside a banquet room available for private functions. It is a short walk from the Gateway SkyTrain station, making it a convenient stop for cyclists travelling along the King George Boulevard corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active, open pub-style lounge (Vimy Lounge) at Whalley Legion Branch 229 with food, drinks, live entertainment and games. A significant address discrepancy exists: OSM records 10767 King George Boulevard while the website's front page states the location is '#102 - 10626 City Parkway'; per the rules the website's current value is preferred and the conflict is flagged. No bike-specific amenities (racks, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the OSM tags or website content.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM records 10767 King George Boulevard but the website front page states the current location is #102 - 10626 City Parkway, Surrey — OSM may reflect an old or incorrect address.
Name discrepancy: OSM uses 'Royal Canadian Legion Branch #229' while the website consistently uses 'Whalley Legion Branch 229'.

Website content shows a GoDaddy filler account (filler@godaddy.com) as logged-in user, suggesting the site template was not fully cleaned up during setup — minor credibility flag but does not indicate the business is closed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible pub and restaurant welcoming to all; a useful food-and-drink stop for touring cyclists near the Gateway SkyTrain corridor.

wow_evidence: served the North Surrey community since 1948
